test_title: PYST 50: SSC CPO - General Intelligence and Reasoning (Held on 03 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Town Q is to the north of Town P. Town R is to the west of Town Q. Town S is to the north of Town R. Town T is to the east of Town S. What is the position of Town T with respect to Town R? (All positions are arranged in GRID pattern).
solution:
Given:

Town Q is to the north of Town P.

Town R is to the west of Town Q.

Town S is to the north of Town R.

Town T is to the east of Town S. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8dfff234104c859414cba670326eca6071cc3064d56b3ed22eaeec881e4d0ce1.png] 

 

So, the position of Town T is '**North-east**' from Town R.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
